_distinct_kpi_signatures.note: episodes whose KPI tables differ (status, escapes, repairs, breaches, fail-safe, outcome, goal, time to safe, true-state distance and ticks, speed, range, offset). An upper bound on behavioural variety: float jitter in repair counts splits symmetric copies

_seeds.note: a deterministic episode repeated on another seed is identical by construction, not spread

warnings: no scorable episode: correctness is undefined, not 0 or 1

_failsafe_labels.observed_as: the escalation FSM entering RTL or Land (Shield.filter's FSM; a Brake or a Loiter is not a fail-safe trigger)

_true_state.basis: true position, harness oracle Shield; the grant's KPI is the Shield's own count (p0_escape_rate), reported unchanged. The autopilot_* figures are the modelled LOITER / RTL / LAND's, outside the Shield's escape rate by definition

results.why: Flown straight at a no-fly zone. The Shield must never let it in.

The curfew fence (weekdays 07:30-17:30) goes out of force while the aircraft is held at its edge: the scenario clock starts at 17:29:40 or 17:29:50 and advances with simulated time, so the window closes at 17:30:00, 20 s or 10 s in. Before the switch the fence must bind; after it nothing may repair against it, and the mission must complete. THE SWITCH INSTANT IS READ FROM THE SHIELD (rule_status in_force), and the t- / t+ boundary check is measured beside it: since 2026-10-07 the Shield reads windows to the microsecond with a closed end (17:30:00.000 is the last instant in force) and judges each instant on both sides (eps = half its forecast step: 0.05 s at the grant's 0.1 s step since 2026-10-12, 0.25 s at the 0.5 s step before), so the fence must stay in force up to the edge and never switch off early (`switch_conservative_nfz-school`). Judged at each forecast pose's own time, a pose past the edge is free, so the Shield lets the aircraft move off the ring in the last seconds and reach the zone just after it closes (`release_gap_s_nfz-school`, reported, not gated): the requirement is that it is never inside while the fence is in force. Until then models.py's minute-resolution reading kept it in force until 17:30:59, and this scenario pinned that, with the clock at 17:30:40 / 17:30:50. At the grant's forecast the band (0.05 s) is narrower than a 0.1 s tick, so the Shield releases the fence on the edge's own tick (switch lag 0.0 s, measured 2026-10-12; 0.2 s at the 0.5 s step), still on the conservative side.

The 07:29:58 opens-on-vehicle cell flown by a pilot holding 2 m/s EAST (review of 69c27bd, P2). The way out is then east, and the corridor-survey-route edge at x = 80 is only 9 m past the school zone's ring at x = 71: in the plain library geometry another hard rule lies within the cap's straight 5 s forecast (20 m) of the exit. On 69c27bd the floored escape was re-checked on that straight forecast, the cap was refused, the escape slowed (3.75, 3.5 ... 2.25 m/s, the speed whose straight forecast ends at x = 80), and from x = 70 the pilot's own 2 m/s broke the corridor and the FSM went Normal > Brake > Loiter: 16 ticks inside the polygon and 4.0 s to safe on the grant arm (8 / 2.9 s on the 3 s arm), with P0 escape 0, against 5 / 2.8 s (7 on the 3 s arm) on 7c9c9e6, every tick escalated and the hold transit at the cap. The escape from a window that opened on the aircraft is now judged as it is flown: out of the ring, then a stop (one forecast step, then 3 m/s^2; guardrail/shield.py Shield._shaped_escape), which ends at x = 74.1 on the grant arm (75.7 on the 3 s arm), short of the corridor edge, so the cap flies. Measured 2026-10-22: 5 / 2.8 s on the grant arm and 7 / 2.8 s on the 3 s arm - 7c9c9e6's counts exactly - 0 P0 escapes, no refused cap or floor, the FSM Normal until the aircraft is out of the ring; then the pilot's 2 m/s east, whose own forecast breaks the corridor from 10 m short of its edge, is projected and the FSM brakes (Normal > Brake, G1), which is the corridor rule doing its job outside the zone, not the escape. Bounds: ticks inside at most 7 (the 3 s arm's count; a family gate is one bound for both arms, and tests/test_window_opens_on.py pins each arm at 7c9c9e6 + 1 for 1 and 2 m/s east and 1 m/s west), time to safe at most 2.9 s, never censored, and no tick refusing the cap or the floor.
